pois.title: Precarious Sojourn
pois.name: Precarious Sojourn
pois.desc: === Description === This location is part of the Arcane Pedestal quest. You acquire both the Imaging Crystal- Arcane Pedestal imprinted and Unframed map of Dereth here. The tower is the home of the famed Alatar Locke.

pois.title: 40.0S, 54.9W - Tumerok Stronghold
pois.name: Tumerok Stronghold
pois.desc:
=== Description === A huge double structure with loads of Tumeroks at 40.0S, 54.9W in the East Direlands.
The NE one is an open structure with 3 towers, the SW one is a closed, and locked, walled structure.
One of the towers has a locked chest (difficulty 80) that contains tier 3 Loot, and the other tower has a portal to Dryreach.

pois.title: 38.1S, 47.3W - Kivik Lir's Temple
pois.name: Kivik Lir's Temple
pois.desc:
=== Description === A Falacatot Temple with loads of Buruns at 38.1S, 47.3W in the Direlands Swamps.
It is one of the POIs indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 36.

pois.title: 45.2S, 83.2W - Tumerok Fort
pois.name: Tumerok Fort
pois.desc:
=== Description === A Renegade Fort in the West Dires near Ayan Baqur.
There is a chest in one of the towers that spawns low tier 4 Loot.
The fort is one of the POIs indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 38

pois.title: 51.1S, 82.0W - Tumerok Fort
pois.name: Tumerok Fort
pois.desc:
=== Description === A Tumerok Fort in the West Dires near Ayan Baqur. The door is unlocked using the Heavy Tumerok Key and a High Priest in one of the towers drops a key used to unlock the final 12.3N, 73.7W - Tumerok Fort in the Overlord's Sword Quest.
This fort is one of the POIs incidated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 39

pois.name: Festival Stone of Darktide
pois.desc: The Festival Stones}} === Description === One of the Festival Stones, located west of Ayan Baqur on a little island for the coast at at 59.7S, 90.0W.

pois.title: Aerbax's Citadel (POI)
pois.name: Aerbax's Citadel
pois.desc: === Description === Aerbax's Citadel high up in the air around 65.0S 63.8W in the center of the Obsidian Plains. It consists of many side platforms around a center. See the quest. === Route ===

pois.title: Necropolis
pois.name: Necropolis
pois.desc: === Description === Ancient burial ground with two bunkers that contain various Mu-miyah. One of bunkers has double stairs that go deeper into catacombs with sarcophagi and multiple chests. One of those chests requires a Sturdy Iron Key, the second spawns low tier loot and the third is unlocked and contains part of Staff of the Nomads. Various Direland creatures spawn on the surface and there is a

pois.title: Small Hill Base
pois.name: Small Hill Base
pois.desc:
=== Description === Drop point of Small Hill Base Portal located on the Small Black Hill.
A short distance from Wai Jhou.

pois.title: Knathtead Excavation
pois.name: Knathtead Excavation
pois.desc: === Description === A narrow valley at 63.1S 44.3W full of higher level Knathteads. Their Mother can be found at the end of the valley. === Route ===

pois.title: Forger's Hideout
pois.name: Forger's Hideout
pois.desc:
=== Description === This location is on the top of an obsidian spire at 76.0S 67.1W and can only be accessed as part of the Counterfeit Writ quest.
The Building is a Mansion-like Structure, with the same lay-out.

pois.title: Planetarium
pois.name: Planetarium
pois.desc:
=== Description === This is one of the POIs seen in the Ingame Map (no. 57 on Points of Interest Map).
A large area with different kind of Empyrean Ruins at 78.8S, 73.8W in the South West Dires near Candeth Keep:

pois.title: Ancient Lugian Fortress
pois.name: Ancient Lugian Fortress
pois.desc: === Description === An ancient Lugian fortress that is seemingly rising from the sea. It has the same layout as Linvak Tukal. Various Lugian relics are strewn about the city, including the Well-Balanced Lugian Greataxe. At the top of the center tower is a Lugian Lifestone. === Route ===

pois.title: Caulcano
pois.name: Caulcano
pois.desc:
=== Description === A huge crater in the center of Singularity Caul.
It is indicated on the Ingame Map. See Points of Interest Map, no. 40.

pois.title: Tombs of the Sand Kings
pois.name: Tombs of the Sand Kings
pois.desc: === Description === === Lore === The left most bunker to the west houses Anadil's Tomb. Anadil of Shakrassekor was one of the Sand Kings and was also the leader of the Dericost forces that attempted to thwart the return of the Hopeslayer by protecting the Soul Stones from being destroyed. He was killed during the Should the Stars Fall event whilst defending the Shard of the Herald at Ithaenc Cathe

pois.title: Abandoned Observatory
pois.name: Abandoned Observatory
pois.desc: === Description === An Observatory that has been taken over by Shadows, it houses a chest which contains a note with the wheareabouts of part of the Staff of the Nomads. The two pieces of the staff were originally held to the south east at the Tombs of the Sand Kings inside Anadil's Tomb. The tombs were raided by the Shadows stationed here under Black Ferah's instructions.

pois.title: The Pit of Heretics
pois.name: The Pit of Heretics
pois.desc: === Description === This ziggurat is located southeast of Candeth Keep at 88.0S, 55.0W and is referenced by Ulgrim the Unpleasant: :You give Ulgrim the Unpleasant Stout.

pois.name: Festival Stone of Dawnsong
pois.desc: The Festival Stones}} === Description === One of the Festival Stones, located east of Candeth Keep near the Southern Landbridge.

pois.title: Burning Wood
pois.name: Burning Wood
pois.desc: === Description === The Burning Wood is the area of the Graveyard found in the valley to the southwest. During the night time, a unique creature called the Corrupted Pyre Oak sometimes appears in the wood at 66.5S, 44.8W. Lord Hendrel also spawns in this area as part of the Castle of Lord Mhoire Quest.

pois.name: Arcanum Lookout
pois.desc: === Description === A floating platform with NPCs on the edge of Graveyard. === Route ===
